show.description: My Accidental Husband is a powerful drama where fate collides two broken lives through a shocking IVF mistake. Payal, abandoned and abused for being childless, finally conceives—only to be discarded by her husband. The child she carries belongs to Ranvijay Rathore, a feared yet principled man bound by legacy and power. As love slowly grows, they face betrayal, violence, and family conspiracies, turning motherhood into a battlefield and love into an act of courage.
